tables.title: O utput control bits for complementary tim_oc1 and tim_oc1n channels with break
tables.text_helper: Table 364, "O utput control bits for complementary tim_oc1 and tim_oc1n channels with break", in section 35.9.8 (TIM capture/compare enable register (TIM_CCER)) on page 1463. Columns: Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Output states(1), Output states(1). 12 data row(s). Notes: 1. When both outputs of a channel are not used (control taken over by the GPIO controller), the OIS1, OIS1N, CC1P and CC1NP bits must be kept cleared.
